name: Cipla Ltd
title: Cipla Ltd - 500087 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Cipla guides FY27 EBITDA margin 18.5-20% and a US$1bn run-rate by FY27 end, excluding Lanreotide; supply-side signals are limited to capex plateauing after 'built enough capacity', with a war-driven cost headwind flagged.

capex.quote: we have capex, which we have increased steadily over the last 3 years. So this cycle will probably reduce after another year or so because we've built enough capacity for the products that we want to supply

triggers.label: FY27 EBITDA margin 18.5-20%
triggers.quote: We expect the EBITDA margins to be in the range of 18.5% to 20% and this would be actually achieved with a sequential improvement quarter-on-quarter

triggers.label: Capex cycle to reduce after ~1 year
triggers.quote: this cycle will probably reduce after another year or so because we've built enough capacity for the products that we want to supply

triggers.label: US run-rate target $1bn by FY27 end
triggers.quote: our aim is to cross $1 billion mark as a run rate towards the end of this financial year, i.e., FY '27

triggers.label: Lanreotide supply disruption, excluded from guidance
triggers.quote: this guidance does not include any contribution from Lanreotide in FY '27

guidance.quote: our aim is to cross $1 billion mark as a run rate towards the end of this financial year, i.e., FY '27
We expect the EBITDA margins to be in the range of 18.5% to 20%
We are guiding towards 7%-ish on R&D spend as a percentage of sales

prior_guidance_check.quote: as we had guided, we were expecting four approvals this year. Ventolin has already got approved

red_flags.label: Lanreotide supply disruption; FY27 guide excludes it
red_flags.quote: this guidance does not include any contribution from Lanreotide in FY '27

red_flags.label: War-driven input and sourcing cost pressure
red_flags.quote: we have started to see some impact of ongoing geopolitical situation within the operating expenses

evasions.quote: the reason we are not able to give a quarter -wise kind of breakup or a product -wise breakup is because the timing of launch
We are waiting for the classification. I can't comment on that.
